description: Search the RoutersUA catalogue of GL.iNet devices (30 products: VPN and Wi-Fi routers, 4G/5G routers, gateways, IP-KVM, eSIM cards) and return the matches with current price in UAH, availability and product page URL. Use it first when the user describes a need or a feature or names a product loosely; then use routersua_get_product for one product's full details, or routersua_compare_products to set models side by side. Every query word must occur in a product's name, model codes, summary, category or specifications; store texts are Ukrainian, while model names and technical terms (Wi-Fi 7, WireGuard, 5G, GL-MT6000) are written as usual. Filters: category, in stock only, maximum price. Without a query it lists the whole catalogue or the filtered part, in catalogue order. When nothing matches, the result is an error that lists every product.

category.description: One category by its slug: portatyvnyj-stilnykovyj-marshrutyzator (4G/5G-роутери з SIM-карткою); wi-fi-router (Wi-Fi роутери з VPN); merezhevyj-shlyuz (Мережевий шлюз); sim-kartki-ta-fizichni-esim-kartki (SIM-картки та фізичні eSIM-картки); ip-kvm (IP-KVM).

in_stock_only.description: true to return only products that ship now (no backorder, no out of stock).

max_price_uah.description: Highest current price in UAH, e.g. 5000.

query.description: Words that must all match, e.g. "Wi-Fi 7", "5G", "WireGuard", "GL-MT6000", "акумулятор". Leave it out to list everything (with the filters).

name: routersua_search_products
title: Search RoutersUA products
